identity.episodeLink: assessment.episodeId identifies that wound's episode when available
identity.legacyPerWoundVisits: read-only-compatible; preserve existing ids and EVV evidence

visit.woundIds: unique discovered/assessed wound ids, may be empty before first assessment
visit.assessmentIds: unique assessment ids belonging to this physical visit
visit.fieldWoundIds: legacy-compatible alias/projection of woundIds while readers migrate
visit.fieldWoundVisitIds: legacy-only; do not generate children for patient_visit
visit.billing: one visit package with per-wound evidence; no automatic extra billable encounter

assessment.visitId: required for new scheduled encounter assessments
assessment.fieldEncounterVisitId: same as physical visit id for new patient_visit

providers.performingClinician: WoundAPP authenticated author; never overwritten by provider of record
providers.providerOfRecord: verified clinical assignment, not inferred from RN
providers.billingProvider: verified assignment; not automatically equivalent to performing clinician
providers.npi: verified provider profile; missing NPI remains explicit blocker

security.assessmentLink: same patient, same physical visit, valid wound and episode
security.dischargedPatient: no new clinical documentation except explicit authorized amendment
